class.name: NNBlackboardSensor
class.brief_description: Scores a blackboard value normalised into a configurable range.
class.description: Reads [member key] from the effective [NNBlackboard] and scores it as a 0..1 sensor value, using [member range_min_value] and [member range_max_value] exactly like [NNFloatRangeSensor]. The board is resolved through the [NoodleNodes] blackboard helpers, which means the nearest ancestor root decides it. A root with no board assigned inherits the board of the nearest ancestor root, and only the outermost root owns a private board, so the sensor usually needs no setup. A [bool] value reads as 1.0 or 0.0, and an [int] or [float] value is used as the number. Any other stored type, a [code]null[/code] value, a missing key or no board at all falls back to [member default_value]. The number is normalised into the range and clamped to 0..1: values below [member range_min_value] score 0 and values above [member range_max_value] score 1. Equal, reversed or non-finite bounds score 0. The sensor is re-evaluated wherever sensors are evaluated: by [NNAgent] before it evaluates its behaviours, by [NNBTRoot] before it ticks its child, and by [NNSTRoot] before it ticks its states. It therefore works under an agent as well as under behaviour-tree and state-tree roots.

members.member: The value scored when [member key] is missing, holds [code]null[/code], holds a type other than [bool], [int] or [float], or no blackboard is available.
The blackboard key to read. An empty key scores [member default_value].
The maximum value for the range. Values above the maximum score 1, and equal, reversed or non-finite bounds score 0. The default 0..1 range scores a [bool] key as 0 or 1 directly.
The minimum value for the range. Values below the minimum score 0.
